source: made up: startup founder juggling an investor call, hiring interviews, gym, and a missed lunch
persona: Rohan, co-founder and CEO of a seed-stage B2B SaaS startup. Texts in ultra-brief, bulleted fragments ('deck done. push lunch. moving to calls'), constantly over-optimistic about how much he can fit between back-to-back Zooms, and protects his morning gym lift as his only sanity anchor.
situation: Monday morning at 06:15. Has a morning gym lift before work, an 11:00 Series A partner pitch call, two afternoon founding-engineer interviews (14:00 and 15:30), a customer escalation, and investor metrics to finalize.
life: 06:20 Wake up and text the app: big Monday. gym 06:45–07:45, shower & protein shake by 08:30. work 08:30–19:30: finalize ARR cohort slide before 11:00 Sequoia pitch, lunch at 12:30, review 2 eng candidate repos before 14:00 & 15:30 interviews, send monthly investor update email, and do co-founder roadmap sync at 17:00. dinner with wife at 20:00.
06:25 Remind the app that the ARR cohort slide deck MUST be locked 30 minutes before the 11:00 investor call so my co-founder can review it.
06:35 Walk to the gym, do heavy deadlifts and bench press, walk back, shower, and blend a protein shake until 08:30.
08:32 Report gym, shower, and shake done. Diving into Stripe export data and the ARR cohort slide.
08:35 Pull Net Dollar Retention numbers and finish the pitch deck slides, sending them to co-founder at 10:25.
10:28 Report deck locked and sent! Reviewing pitch talking points for 30 minutes before the 11:00 Sequoia call.
11:00 Pitch call with Sequoia partner; partner asks deep follow-up questions on enterprise security compliance, running until 12:10.

12:12 Right as you hang up, head of sales Slacks: largest pilot customer (Acme Corp) is threatening to pause rollout over an SSO login bug and wants a call at 12:30. Text the app: Sequoia call ran to 12:10, went well! Now jumping on an emergency customer call with Acme Corp 12:30–13:15—push lunch and eng candidate repo review to 13:15.
12:25 Jump on the emergency Zoom with Acme Corp VP of IT and walk through the hotfix timeline until 13:20.

13:22 Text the app: Acme fire put out, they're staying on! Only have 35 mins before the 14:00 founding eng interview and haven't looked at either candidate's GitHub repo yet. Skip lunch—I'll grab a handful of almonds and review the repos right now.
13:25 Skim both engineering candidates' GitHub take-home repos and jot down technical questions while eating almonds at the desk until 13:58.
14:00 Conduct Founding Engineer Interview #1 until 15:00, then spend 25 minutes writing hiring scorecard notes and answering urgent investor follow-up emails until 15:25.
15:30 Conduct Founding Engineer Interview #2 until 16:30.

16:32 Text the app: both eng interviews and scorecards done! Starving because I completely missed lunch—going to heat up a chicken burrito bowl right now for 25 minutes before my 17:00 co-founder sync.
16:35 Heat up and wolf down a chicken burrito bowl until 16:58.
17:00 Co-founder roadmap and hiring debrief sync until 18:05.
18:08 Report late lunch/snack and co-founder sync done. Drafting and sending the October monthly investor update email and Sequoia data-room link before logging off at 19:30.
18:10 Write the monthly investor update email and upload the cohort CSV to the data room, hitting send at 19:25.
19:28 Report investor update sent and workday done! Drop clearing out the garage recycling for tonight—walking to the neighborhood trattoria to meet wife for 20:00 dinner.
20:00 Eat pasta dinner with wife at the restaurant and walk home by 21:45, then read until 23:30.
constraints: Morning gym session (06:45–07:45) is non-negotiable before starting the workday at 08:30.
Pitch deck cohort slides must be finished by 10:30 (30 minutes before the 11:00 investor pitch).
Must review engineering candidates' GitHub take-home repos before the 14:00 interview starts.
